newsitem.title: USA: U.S. spot jet prices firm as NYMEX extends gains.
newsitem.headline: U.S. spot jet prices firm as NYMEX extends gains.

text.p: U.S. spot jet fuel prices moved higher Tuesday on the back of the continued NYMEX strength, as well as slightly firming differentials.
However, activity remained very subdued, with few players entering the market in search of barrels, traders said.
U.S. Gulf prices showed some strength early in the day as prompt 54-grade fuel emerged on offer at 0.25 cents under the NYMEX print, though traders saw no takers emerge.
New York Harbor 54-grade jet fuel was talked between 3.25 to 3.50 cents over the screen, a gain of about 0.25 cent from the previous day's level.
